name: OCEANIC-STROKE
teachingPoint: Asundexian on top of antiplatelets cut ischaemic stroke ~26% without more major bleeding — could reshape noncardioembolic prevention.

name: MATCH
fullName: Aspirin and Clopidogrel Compared with Clopidogrel Alone after Recent Ischaemic Stroke or TIA in High-Risk Patients
population: n=7599, adults, NIHSS recent ischemic stroke or TIA plus ≥1 additional vascular risk factor, 18 months of treatment and follow-up
teachingPoint: Adding aspirin to clopidogrel for 18 months after stroke/TIA gave no significant benefit and doubled life-threatening bleeding.
